submission.postalAddress: Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht, Postfach 1349, 91504 Ansbach, Germany

procedural.notes: The BayLDA supervises private-sector controllers established in Bavaria (public-sector controllers in Bavaria fall under the separate Bayerischer Landesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz). Complaints can be filed via the online form at lda.bayern.de/de/beschwerde.html (10 MB attachment limit), by email to poststelle@lda.bayern.de, or by post to Postfach 1349, 91504 Ansbach. Working language is German. BayLDA has been an active enforcer on website tracking, notably issuing a 2022 decision against a publisher for unlawful Google Fonts embedding.
